versions.changelog:
pet-flavor-trial v0.1.1

- Initial public version released.
- Added detailed guidance and structured output for DTC pet treat brands to create flavor-variety trial/assortment bundles.
- Provides bundle definition, flavor mix, naming, copy suggestions, and key trial/repurchase metrics.
- Includes ready-to-use copy blocks, placement/UX recommendations, and validation plan.
- Modular reference and supporting files added for evaluations and documentation.

Initial release of pet-flavor-trial

- Skill helps DTC pet treat brands design flavor-variety trial bundles and assortment packs to drive trial and repeat purchase.
- Guides users through optimal bundle definition, naming, product copy, placement, and key metrics.
- Includes a detailed question set to tailor assortment offers by product and flavor mix.
- Provides ready-to-use table formats, copy blocks, and a validation plan for bundle performance.
- Outputs are platform-agnostic and focus on clear, actionable merchandising steps.
